subject: Error in t(Z) %*% Z : requires numeric/complex matrix/vector arguments

messages.author: ef49ed6122073bff
messages.subject: Error in t(Z) %*% Z : requires numeric/complex matrix/vector arguments
parts:
Hi Karl,

I'm trying to get an effect size estimation from MQM. The final model has 4 additive QTL and I'm using cross (fam) as a covariate. 

> qtl1d.int.m.refine4.eff<-fitqtl(qtl1d.int.m.sim,qtl=qtl1d.int.refine4.cov,covar=fam,formula=y~Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4+fam,dropone=FALSE,get.est=TRUE)
Error in t(Z) %*% Z : requires numeric/complex matrix/vector arguments

I don't understand what the error message is saying. Could you please help me? In the past, this command has always worked. 

> qtl1d.int.m.fit.refine4.cov<-fitqtl(qtl1d.int.m.sim,qtl=qtl1d.int.refine4.cov,covar=fam,formula=y~Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4+fam)
did work and there was no error message. So the error is coming from estimating effect sizes. 

Many thanks!

Best,
Mingzi

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error in t(Z) %*% Z : requires numeric/complex matrix/vector arguments
parts:
The model is maybe over-specified (you're trying to estimate more things than the data will allow).
and so while we can get a LOD score, we can't get the set of estimated coefficients.

karl

Hi Karl,

Thanks! I found out why. I defined "fam" as a factor when I was testing for family effect on phenotype earlier and forgot to change it back to numeric... Sorry to bother you about my stupid mistake.

Best,
Mingzi
